about: Run-level aggregates of the Studio verifier's evaluations on SciFact proxy sets, 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-26. Built offline from the private run folders by showcase/make_evaluation_runs.py; no claim ids, claim text, passages or quotes. Phase 11B (the earlier research backend) is not part of it.

target.note: Three-class (SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, NOT_ENOUGH_INFO). The historical Arm C figure is two-class and is not evidence for this target.

scorer.failures: a failed or missing record counts as NOT_ENOUGH_INFO in every metric
